subject: seg06-reader: claim .github/workflows/ci.yml and add both steps yourself (seg05-seed has finished)
body: Add (1) NAADI_AUTH_STORAGE_UPSTREAM=127.0.0.1:5000 to the auth gateway step and (2) a migrate + seed step (local storage URL + locally minted storage service key) before build/playwright in the e2e job. Keep S02's storage steps and seg03-auth's auth/mailpit steps intact (seg03-auth is reworking ci.yml for its review fixes — claim, integrate small, rebase often). Artifacts: screenshots only, never traces/reports with tokens; extend the artifact secret scan to your paths.
